BottleneckType.description:
Bottleneck classification types for GPU kernels.

Math-level (Stage 1 - roofline-based):
    Derived from compute intensity analysis. These represent the
    theoretical performance ceiling based on the math operations.

Implementation-level (Stage 2 - profiler-detected):
    Detected during optimization via NCU/nsys. These represent
    issues with the current implementation, not the algorithm.
BottleneckType.title: BottleneckType

validation.description:
Output schema for Stage 1 Benchmarking Agent.

This structured output captures the complete analysis of a reference
kernel implementation, including both theoretical (math-based) and
empirical (NCU-based) bottleneck classification.

The final_bottleneck field is used by Stage 2 to filter which
ProfilingTools are relevant for the optimization.

invalid_reference_code.description: Set to True if the reference code is invalid, unparseable, or cannot be analyzed. When True, other fields may contain placeholder values and should not be trusted.
invalid_reference_code.title: Invalid Reference Code

math_operations.description: List of mathematical operations identified in the code. Examples: ['GEMM', 'Softmax', 'LayerNorm', 'Conv2d']
math_operations.title: Math Operations

dominant_operation.description: The primary operation that dominates runtime. Examples: 'GEMM', 'Softmax', 'Attention'
dominant_operation.title: Dominant Operation

problem_dimensions_str.description: Key dimensions extracted from the code as a string. Examples: 'M=4096, N=4096, K=4096' for GEMM, 'batch=32, seq_len=512, hidden=768' for transformer
problem_dimensions_str.title: Problem Dimensions Str

total_flops.description: Total floating point operations. GEMM: 2*M*N*K, Softmax: ~5*N per row, etc.
total_flops.title: Total Flops

total_bytes.description: Total memory traffic in bytes. Include input reads + output writes + any intermediate buffers.
total_bytes.title: Total Bytes

compute_intensity.description: Arithmetic intensity = total_flops / total_bytes. Higher values indicate more compute-bound kernels.
compute_intensity.title: Compute Intensity

theoretical_bottleneck.description: Bottleneck type from theoretical roofline analysis. Based on compute_intensity vs ridge point.

actual_bottleneck.description: Bottleneck type from NCU profiling. Based on sm_throughput vs dram_throughput comparison.

classification_match.description: Whether theoretical and actual classifications agree. Mismatch may indicate implementation inefficiency.
classification_match.title: Classification Match

final_bottleneck.description: The bottleneck classification used for Stage 2 tool filtering. When classifications match, use that. When they differ, trust theoretical (represents ceiling).

sm_throughput.description: SM (compute) throughput as percentage of peak. High values (>60%) indicate compute-bound.
sm_throughput.title: Sm Throughput

dram_throughput.description: DRAM (memory) throughput as percentage of peak. High values (>60%) indicate memory-bound.
dram_throughput.title: Dram Throughput

reference_latency_ms.description: Reference kernel execution time in milliseconds. Used as baseline for speedup calculations.
reference_latency_ms.title: Reference Latency Ms

occupancy.description: Achieved occupancy as percentage. Low values may indicate register pressure.
occupancy.title: Occupancy

kernel_name.description: Name of the profiled CUDA kernel.
kernel_name.title: Kernel Name

achievable_speedup.description: Estimated achievable speedup based on roofline gap. 1.0 means already at theoretical peak.
achievable_speedup.title: Achievable Speedup

recommended_techniques.description: Optimization techniques recommended based on bottleneck type. Examples: ['tensor_cores', 'memory_coalescing', 'kernel_fusion']
recommended_techniques.title: Recommended Techniques

analysis_notes.description: Additional notes about the analysis, especially if theoretical and actual classifications differ.
analysis_notes.title: Analysis Notes
